summary: First iteration full-stack testing of DriveHub UK driving instructor/student portal. Backend (FastAPI + JWT + MongoDB) auth verified end-to-end with 18/18 pytest cases passing (login, register, /me, role separation, token validation, duplicate handling, validation errors). Frontend Expo web preview tested for both instructor and student demo flows: sign-in/up tabs, demo panel, KPI grid, MTD card, earnings bar chart, Students CRM (search + 4 filter chips + 6 student cards), Add New Student bottom sheet (5-field form + green snackbar), student lifecycle screen with 4 tabs, lesson diary weekly grid (Mon-Sun + 08:00-19:00 + lesson block), DL25 mock test (12 categories, +/- counters working), DL25 report (PASS card + fault summary + breakdown + Retake + Back to My Learning), student home (Driving Readiness 4/5 + DVSA competency grid + Mock Test widget + Lesson Feedback), profile screen, instructor logout, student logout, invalid-credentials error message. All critical user journeys defined in the request work correctly.

minor.issue: Backend logs show 'passlib AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' at startup. Functional impact is zero (passwords hash & verify correctly, all auth tests pass) but the warning is noisy. Caused by passlib 1.7.x + bcrypt>=4. Optional: pin bcrypt==4.0.1 or upgrade passlib.

issues: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated, use boxShadow' repeatedly. Cosmetic only — RN web noise from current React Native Web. Consider replacing shadow* props with boxShadow for cleaner logs.

Bottom nav is not rendered on the report screen (nor on the lifecycle/competency-detail/lesson-diary screens). Users return via the in-screen 'Back to My Learning' / back arrow, which works, but a consistent bottom tab on these inner screens would be more typical for a tab-based mobile app. Not a blocker.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic; from a third-party (lucide-react-native or expo) component.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Suppress passlib bcrypt __about__ warning by pinning bcrypt==4.0.1 in backend/requirements.txt or upgrading passlib.
(Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* RN style props with boxShadow to reduce console noise on web.
(Optional) Consider showing the bottom nav on dl25-report-screen, lesson-diary-screen, competency-detail-screen and student-lifecycle-screen for navigation consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured, async-only, uses Pydantic for validation, excludes Mongo _id and password from /me response, and creates a unique index on email. Demo seeding is idempotent.
Frontend api.ts correctly reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env with no hardcoded fallbacks and uses a Platform-aware token store (localStorage on web, SecureStore on native).
All interactive elements on tested screens have stable testID attributes, which made automation reliable.
Backend file size (218 lines) and frontend screen files are within the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (sign-in, demo instructor login → home, KPIs/MTD/chart, CRM filters/cards/FAB/add-student/snackbar, lifecycle route, diary grid + week nav, instructor logout, demo student login → student-home, readiness + competency + mock widget, mock test 12 categories + counters, finish → DL25 report PASS card + fault summary + retake/back, profile, student logout, invalid-credentials error)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed (instructor@demo.uk / student@demo.uk) is auto-created on startup. One TEST_playwright student was added through the Add Student bottom sheet during UI testing — this is in-memory mock data (mockDb.ts) and clears on full reload. Test users with TEST_user_*@example.com prefix were created by pytest and cleaned up afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py and use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via conftest.py. Frontend uses correct testIDs: nav-tab-{home|diary|students|learning|mock|profile}, btn-logout (instructor home), btn-signout (profile), qa-students/qa-diary, fab-add-student, sheet-add-student, btn-submit-student, btn-finish-test, {category-key}-{driving|serious|dangerous}-{add|sub|val}, comp-{key} (student home competency cards — NOT competency-card-*), student-card-{id}. Domain data (students, lessons, competencies, earnings) is fully mocked in /app/frontend/src/mockDb.ts.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. All listed feature requirements verified working.
